confidence_rules: A finding needs: n >= min_posts (series x platform) matured posts, at least min_consistency of those posts on the same side of the platform median (index>1 or <1), and, for TikTok, average watch time pointing the same way. Otherwise it is reported as 'not enough data'.
big_changes_need_user_approval: dropping, pausing or replacing a series
adding a new series or changing the rotation
stopping a series on a platform (platform routing)
changing posting times or the queue/instant mode
any change to caption rules beyond soft style weights
anything touching template, colours, verification standards or hashtag limits (these are never changed by the brain)
auto_allowed: soft guidance on caption hook style per platform (hook type, length range, question/number first) inside brand.md limits
adding evidence to the scorecard and insights
